audit.working: max(Value in use measured-value-in-use = 300; Fair value less costs of disposal [(some? cgu.fvlcd) = false] n/a) → Value in use

audit.label: Loss assigned to shared facilities
audit.formula: (get (alloc/pro-rata (- impairment-loss loss-to-goodwill) {:corporate corporate-share :own (- carrying-amount (or cgu.goodwill 0))} rounding) :corporate)
audit.working: (- impairment-loss loss-to-goodwill) = 60 → (or cgu.goodwill 0) = 30 → (- carrying-amount (or cgu.goodwill 0)) = 360 → (alloc/pro-rata (- impairment-loss loss-to-goodwill) {:corporate corporate-share :own (- carrying-amount (or cgu.goodwill 0))} rounding) = {:corporate 0, :own 60} → (get (alloc/pro-rata (- impairment-loss loss-to-goodwill) {:corporate corporate-share :own (- carrying-amount (or cgu.goodwill 0))} rounding) :corporate) = 0
